title: Watrana Rentals IPO
summary: Watrana Rentals IPO is a ₹120.1 crore book-built issue priced at ₹232–₹245 per share, to be listed on NSE SME. It is open from November 19 to November 23, 2026, with allotment expected on November 25 and listing on November 27, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹2,94,000 for 1,200 shares.

b.p: Watrana Rentals IPO GMP today is ₹38 per share (a 16% premium over the ₹245 upper price band) as of 23 Nov 2026, 11:25 AM IST. The indicative listing price is ₹283 (₹245 upper price band + ₹38 GMP). GMP fell ₹2 from the previous recorded quote.
During the recorded period, Watrana Rentals IPO GMP ranged from ₹15 to ₹45.
The latest GMP is ₹38, down from ₹40.

Watrana Rentals Limited, incorporated on November 19, 2019, is a specialist in renting material and cargo handling equipment. The equipment fleet consists of forklifts (electric, diesel, gas), electric stackers, pallet trucks, specialty attachments (paper roll clamps, bale clamps, side shifters), and ground support equipment. · · The above-mentioned business of the company can be classified into the following:- · Rental solutions: Provides rental services for MHEs, which are flexible and require no capital investment. · Trading in MHE: Trading in MHEs is a part of the company's business, which enables customers to purchase material handling equipment according to their budget and requirements. · Trading in batteries for MHEs: Various batteries for different MHE models are available for rental and trading clients. · · As of June 30, 2026, the company had a fleet of two thousand six hundred forty-six (2,646) MHE units and thirty-three (33) AWP units, along with five MHE units and two AWP units rented from third parties. · As of June 30, 2026, The company had 3,883 employees in various fields, such as strategy and planning, administration and human resources, finance, operations, procurement, stores, safety and service.
Sanjeev Kumar Watrana, Rajeev Kumar Watrana, Neha Watrana are the company's promoters of Watrana Rentals.

b.p: Watrana Rentals Limited has allocated 13,86,000 equity shares to anchor investors at ₹245 per share, raising ₹33.96 crore ahead of its IPO. · · The allocation was made to 8 institutional investors, including Old Bridge Flexi Cap Fund, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, SageOne Small and Micro Opportunity Fund, BTH Classic Growth Fund, Aarth AIF Growth Fund and 238 Plan Associates LLC. One domestic mutual fund scheme, Old Bridge Flexi Cap Fund, received 4,08,600 shares (29.48% of the anchor portion).
